PUBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
MINUTES

Due to the Martin Luther King Jr, holiday a meeting of the Public Services Committee was instead
held on Wednesday, January 18, 2023, in Committee Room 104 and via electronic meeting,
starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Bryan Cook, Chairman, Pete Laybourn, Dr. Mark Rinne and Tom
Segrave.

a a ey
AGENDA ITEMS

18. ORDINANCE -2" READING — Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land
located southwest of the intersection of Ridge Road and Holland Court. (SPONSOR -
MR. COOK)

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2 reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried with Dr.
Rinne and Mr. Segrave voting “YES” and Mr. Laybourn voting “NO”.

Charles Bloom, Planning & Development Department Director, provided a staff report. Brad
Emmons, AVIP.C., provided additional information. Committee members Laybourn and Segrave
commented on the item. Public comments on the item were made by Roger Alexander, John Cecil,
and Alex Sutton.

19. ORDINANCE -2" READING ~ Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from County A-I Agriculture and Rural
Residential to NR-3 Neighborhood Residential-High Density for land located southwest of
the intersection of Ridge Road and Holland Court. (SPONSOR - MR. COOK)

Dr. Rinne excused himself from the meeting at 12:52 p.m. during discussion, and prior to the vote,
‘on item #19, due to a previous employment commitment.

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2 reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion failed with
Mr. Laybourn and Mr, Segrave voting “NO”.

Charles Bloom, Planning & Development Department Director, provided a staff report and Tom
Cobb, City Engineer, provided additional information. Brad Emmons, AVI P.C., and Jason
Stephen, Gateway Construction, provided additional information. Committee members Laybourn
Segrave commented on the item. Public Comments on the item were made by Roger Alexander,
John Cecil, Alicia Kroates, Charles Marsh, Rebecca Murchie, Amber Reagan, Paul Ricketts, and
Mark Stokes. A letter was also read and submitted from Peggy and Tony Escamilla.

20. ORDINANCE ~2” READING — Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land
located east of Southwest Drive north of I-80. (SPONSOR ~ MR. COOK)
